patterns.message: Import a module only through its public index (e.g. '@/modules/sheets'), so each module can change its internals independently.
lib/ was replaced by core/ (shared kernel) and modules/ (feature modules). See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
core/ is the shared kernel and must not depend on feature modules or the app.
Import other modules only through their public index.
Modules must not depend on the app layer.
